title: EMG Recovery Authority Governed Provisioning Contract (ADR-044/ADR-045 S6)
description: The single authoritative, declarative source of what must exist, be bound, be deployed, and be executed -- and in what order -- before a Recovery Authority environment's first legitimate genesis can run (bootstrap.ExecuteGenesis). Contains no project ID, credential, or literal resource identifier -- only placeholder patterns, IDs cross-referencing iam/manifest.json's principals, and paths to already-committed repository files (infra/kubernetes/base/*.yaml). This is NOT an executable provisioning tool: it creates, applies, or binds no real GCP resource, IAM policy, or Kubernetes object. See README.md for why this is JSON, not Terraform.

pattern.description: A GCP resource-name PATTERN with {placeholder} segments only, matching iam/manifest.json's own convention.

principal_id.description: Must match a principal id in iam/manifest.json -- validated by contract.go's cross-reference check, not merely by convention.

kubernetes_service_account.description: The Kubernetes ServiceAccount name this principal's Workload Identity Federation binding attaches to (infra/kubernetes/base/service-accounts.yaml), or 'none' for a principal with no standing Kubernetes workload (e.g. the bootstrap principal, which is never deployed as a long-running pod).

gcp_service_account_placeholder.description: The {placeholder}-form GCP service-account identity this binding targets -- never a literal email.

standing_grant.description: false for recovery-bootstrap-deployment (temporary, revoked after genesis, S6 Phase 2); true for every ordinary runtime principal.

kubernetes_manifest_path.description: Repository-relative path to an already-committed infra/kubernetes/base/*.yaml file (S6 Phase 7). This contract never embeds manifest content -- it only points at it, so the manifest and this contract cannot drift into two competing copies.

principal_id.description: Must match a principal id in iam/manifest.json.

automated.description: true if a committed Go entry point performs this step (e.g. bootstrap.ExecuteGenesis); false if it is a manual_steps entry (cross-referenced by id).

owner.description: The principal id, human role, or 'dual-control-approval' responsible for this step.

depends_on.description: IDs of execution_step entries that must complete first. An empty array means this step has no in-contract prerequisite.

manual_step_ref.description: For automated=false steps, the corresponding manual_steps id.

why_not_automated.description: Why this step is genuinely external rather than a repository-automatable gap (e.g. 'no executable GCP IaC framework exists in this repository -- S4 finding' or 'gcswitness's ADR-043 boundary structurally forbids bucket-attribute mutation').
